summary: NewGenIvf Group Ltd issued 3,666,667 new shares and made a US$10 million investment to acquire a 10% equity interest in K25.ai, an AI-powered live-streaming prediction market platform, via strategic share purchase agreements. The filing is a Form 6-K with a press release attached, disclosing the transaction and reporting a market capitalization of ~US$7.6 million (as of June 18, 2026). No board recommendation or advisors are named. The deal increases outstanding shares to 10,073,535 and strengthens the balance sheet. Management views the market cap as a discount to NAV of ~US$25.98 million. Watch for regulatory compliance with Nasdaq's proposed $5 million MVLS threshold; risk-arb focus on integration and shareholder dilution.
